description: Plan de voirie - Mobiliers urbains - Bornes - Barrières - Potelets is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements - Ville de Paris. Potelet pour véhicule - Arceau pour véhicule - Muret pour véhicule - Borne de voirie - Anneau au sol - Borne de voirie escamotable - Bitte d'amarrage - Borne à vélos - Arceau pour deux roues - Epingle deux roues moto - Epingle deux roues vélo - Accroche vélo - Arrêtoir a vélos - Bornette ... Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Aménagement du territoire, Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Mobilier urbain, Stationnement, Vélo, Circulation, Borne électrique. The portal shows 1,646,050 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
